PART_B.model_e_status: Model E inactive on baseline curves
PART_B.reason: In simulate_modes_at_lap, base_preds is computed from predict_causal_baseline (polynomial + early laps offset). For observed laps i < target_lap, g_t is set to act_t - base_t. Then update_k_factor computes pred = base_t + k*g_t, giving err = act_t - pred = 0.0 when k=1.0. Thus k is never updated away from 1.0.
